title: Refuse a cap that leaves a suspect or orphan concept unconfirmed
action: Add check (d) to the cap-time sync door (D4 e7e80d78) by the Cap door paragraph in plan.md Approach. sync_door.rs `sync_refusal` (anchor: `pub(crate) fn sync_refusal(root: &Path, cell: &Map<String, Value>, touched: &[String]) -> Option<String> {`) gains a `history_root: &Path` parameter (the checkout whose HEAD the cell committed into), and handlers_close.rs passes the `history_root` it already builds touched_set from (anchor: `if let Some(refusal) = sync_refusal(root, &cell_map, &touched_set) {`). Check (d), after (c): grade the areas/ concepts of `history_root`'s docs/knowledge with freshness::grade_bundle; for every concept whose `bee.anchors` (normalized with normalize_cell_path) intersects `touched`, the cap passes when the concept's own repo path is in `touched`, or its grade is confirmed or unverified; it refuses on suspect or orphan with `capCell: SYNC_DOOR — cell "<id>" touches <paths> anchored by knowledge concept(s): <concept path> (<grade>)…. FIX: for suspect, bee knowledge confirm --id <bee.id> (or --path <file>), then add the concept file to the cell's files and reservation and commit it with the cell; for orphan, fix the concept's bee.anchors; or pass --sync-ack "<reason>" to cap anyway (the reason is recorded on trace.sync_ack and trace.deviations).` A missing docs/knowledge/ or an empty areas/ makes (d) a no-op. The existing --sync-ack escape covers (d) with no new flag. In skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md, under the worker contract ("Execute"), add one step before the commit: run `bee knowledge check --json`; for every suspect concept anchored by a file you changed, fix the concept or run `bee knowledge confirm --id <id>`, reserve and commit the concept file with the cell — cite this feature's CONTEXT.md D4 by path, no second copy of the grade rule. Because skills/ is hashed by the release manifest, run `cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml` then `bee dev regen` and include the regenerated manifest. Tests red-first in cells/tests.rs, every test name starting with `sync_door_`, on a fixture repo with a bundle and real commits: a cap touching an anchored file with the concept suspect refuses and names the concept, the grade and the confirm remedy; the same for orphan with the anchors remedy; an unverified concept passes; passes when the concept file is in the touched set; passes after `knowledge confirm` with the concept committed; passes with --sync-ack and records the reason; a touched file anchored by no concept passes; a repo without a bundle caps as before; a cell committed in a granted worktree is graded against the worktree's bundle, not main's. REWORK after the semantic judge NEEDS_REVISION (owner task t-ae0fad): check (d) must match a touched file against each anchor with the same cover rule the grade uses — a directory anchor covers every file under it (freshness.rs anchor_touched; kfm-1 rework exposes it as one pub(crate) function in freshness.rs, call that, no second copy of the rule). Add red-first tests sync_door_refuses_a_file_under_a_suspect_directory_anchor and sync_door_passes_a_sibling_path_that_only_shares_the_directory_prefix_text (src/ab.rs is not under anchor src/a). Remove the /// doc block above sync_refusal that this cell edited, since code comments are refused.
